data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to fetch Android Play Store install referrer details
data.what_it_does: It retrieves the install referrer data from Google Play Services, handling timeouts and preventing ANRs. The plugin throws an exception on iOS or when Play Services are unavailable.
use_when: Tracking install source for marketing attribution
Collecting campaign data after app install
Integrating with analytics SDKs that require referrer info
avoid_when: You don't need install referrer data
strengths: No extra permissions beyond Play Services
